checks.detail: coverage.baseline.closure_candidate.ab52206012fd=insufficient_evidence; Full Chapter 1 closeout remains unassessed. Reachable startup and dynamic source paths provide the village, unarmed Ranger and opening conversation, but do not establish the required acquisition/training, combat/reward, death recovery, upgrade, cinematic, bridge/light-pillar progression or 15-dialogue/supply routes. The mandatory connected-slice closure recipe cannot complete. Current-phase camera and environment patrols found no remaining lamp obstruction or demonstrated lighting failure; Isha clothing fails presentation acceptance. coverage.baseline.adjacent_continuity.1fa5438163b4=insufficient_evidence; The single adjacent boundary inspected was the chapter passage toward MAP02, whose ordinary transition was not demonstrated. More distant content was not inspected.

Independent ordinary input establishes unarmed approach, conversation, Q01 commitment and persistent XP 0→10 without duplicate rewards. It does not establish conversational sword/bow/lamp acquisition and use, armor effects or duplicate equipment prevention, so the full criterion remains blocked. The selected conversation condition fails finished presentation because both portraits are absent; nested settings retain unfinished presentation. Risk-weighted discovery covered unconfirmed-choice restart, held-input release and reserved/remapped controls. Unimplemented combat routes and lower-risk unrelated demo controls were not repeatedly searched.

The opening story interaction is independently exercised, but it cannot prove NPC demonstrations, safe combat practice, actual hit/defense/reveal/skill outcomes, retry rewards or training prerequisite recovery. Relevant connected gameplay routes were not established by source and live startup review. Full acceptance remains blocked; no candidate counters or Developer observations were promoted to a pass. Obstructed interaction and every 200% focus/scroll state remain unverified.

developer_outcome.summary: Developer observed approach, dialogue pause and Q01 commitment. Independent restart/recovery replay and state-bound lamp-route recapture remain unperformed. Host discloses no candidate action/observation contract and its approved computer-use backend is not ready.

risk_note.summary: Independent interaction and recovery evidence is the most likely source of insufficient_evidence: review_r04/review_r22 are declared non-executable reviews, no candidate action/observation vocabulary is disclosed, and the computer-use backend is not ready.
risk_note.validation: Developer checks the registered action/observation surface and supplies candidate-owned state visibility through existing authorized interfaces. Host/Tester owns independent ordinary-input replay, restart and state-bound frame recapture. If that path cannot execute, report the exact missing Host capability and leave acceptance unresolved.
risk_note.why_now: The opening module creates the first genuine story interaction while the pinned camera defect must enter this bounded window; neither candidate counters nor source inspection can validate those player outcomes.

task_requirements.requirement: Through ordinary movement and E interaction, an unarmed player can reach Isha, read and choose within the finished D01–D03 conversation, accept Q01 for exactly one 10 XP award, and return to exploration; the same conversation and committed result survive exit, nested save/menu use and restart without accidental submission or repeated rewards.

On the recorded lamp route, fresh shipped-camera sprint, stopped-idle and Roll views show the Ranger's face and central body readable in both shoulders, including the nearby stop around (18.44,-2.8,18.08), with grounded traversal and controllable recovery preserved.
